missing_values: Empty CSV cells are missing/suppressed, not zero. Percentages are 0-100; ratios are fractions. No statistical independence is implied by rows.

fields.cohort: Curated specialist lender series or wider mixed property-funding ecosystem. Cohorts overlap; never add together.
fields.quarter: Calendar transaction or decision quarter YYYY-Qn; charge quarter follows source methodology. Periods have different data vintages.
fields.charges: Recorded charges in source cohort and quarter. Not monetary lending, unique new loans or site count.
fields.borrowers: Source distinct corporate borrower count in cohort and quarter; not deduplicated developer groups.
fields.active_lenders: Source lender count meeting >=3 recorded charges in quarter; retained aggregate.
fields.any_activity_lenders: Source lender count with >=1 recorded charge in quarter; retained aggregate.
fields.top5_share_pct: Source aggregate share of charges attributed to five largest contributors, rounded percentage. Cannot reconstruct from public lender-level data, which are not supplied.
fields.top10_share_pct: Source aggregate share of charges attributed to ten largest contributors, rounded percentage.
fields.hhi: Source Herfindahl-Hirschman statistic, retained aggregate. No competition-law classification applied.
fields.provisional: True for Q3 2026 charge data. Later filings can revise counts and shares.
